fixed_spread_5_ticks.assumption: Every bar is forced to a 5-tick bid/ask spread inside the exact engine.

contract_month_robustness.definition: Production candidate evaluated separately on each monthly WDO contract bucket from the daily contract_id series.

notes: This pass stress-tests the exact production candidate, not the MT5 base preset.
The 5-tick spread scenario is intentionally harsh and uses a fixed spread rather than a multiplier on the cached 0/1 tick tape.
Contract-month robustness uses the daily contract_id buckets already present in the dataset and scores each contract month independently.
